summary.text: Tracey Quint is the Libertarian candidate for South Dakota House of Representatives District 11, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Libertarian Party convention on May 2, 2026.
She is a former chair of the Libertarian Party of South Dakota and was the party's candidate for governor in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Tracey Quint previously served as chair of the Libertarian Party of South Dakota.
In the November 8, 2022 general election for governor, she received 9,983 votes, or 2.9 percent, finishing behind Republican incumbent Kristi Noem and Democrat Jamie Smith.
